build.buildCommand: cd Whisper-of-Hope && bash -c 'echo "Current directory structure:" && find app/Http/Controllers -type d -name "*" | head -20 && echo "Fixing PSR-4 directory structure..." && if [ -d "app/Http/Controllers/user" ]; then echo "Found lowercase user directory, renaming..."; rm -rf app/Http/Controllers/User 2>/dev/null || true; mv app/Http/Controllers/user app/Http/Controllers/User; fi && if [ -d "app/Http/Controllers/admin" ]; then echo "Found lowercase admin directory, renaming..."; rm -rf app/Http/Controllers/Admin 2>/dev/null || true; mv app/Http/Controllers/admin app/Http/Controllers/Admin; fi && if [ -d "app/Http/Controllers/User/auth" ]; then echo "Found lowercase auth directory, renaming..."; rm -rf app/Http/Controllers/User/Auth 2>/dev/null || true; mv app/Http/Controllers/User/auth app/Http/Controllers/User/Auth; fi && echo "Directory structure after fixes:" && find app/Http/Controllers -type d -name "*" | head -20 && echo "Installing composer dependencies..." && composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader --no-interaction && echo "Installing npm dependencies..." && npm install && echo "Building assets..." && npm run build'
